optimizer_gist:
This optimization history reveals a critical flaw: the tuning process repeatedly evaluated the exact same parameter configuration across all 50 iterations. Consequently, no meaningful parameter exploration occurred, and the observed reward fluctuations (13.7 to 17.32) are solely due to measurement noise or inherent system variability. The "optimal" configuration found (reward 17.32) is merely the best outcome from 50 runs of the *same* static configuration.

For future runs, it is essential to debug the tuning framework to ensure it actively proposes and tests different parameter combinations within their defined ranges. Without proper parameter exploration, no insights can be gained into which parameters have an impact, nor can a truly optimized configuration be identified beyond the baseline.
